تباطأت (form VI)
# تَبَاطَأْتُ (tabāṭaʔtu) /ta.baː.tˤaʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa)
# تَبَاطَأْتَ (tabāṭaʔta) /ta.baː.tˤaʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa)
# تَبَاطَأْتِ (tabāṭaʔti) /ta.baː.tˤaʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa)
# تَبَاطَأَتْ (tabāṭaʔat) /ta.baː.tˤa.ʔat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
